name: @lloydrichards/shared-skills
description: Editable skill source and lab-skills CLI; not an npm source distribution

scripts.test: bun run build && turbo run test && bun run test:skills
scripts.test:bun: bun run build && turbo run test:bun
scripts.format: oxfmt apps/lab-skills packages/config-typescript packages/lab-skills/bin package.json tsconfig.json turbo.json stack.effect.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.jsonc .vscode .github/workflows/ci.yml tests/skills
scripts.tui: bun run build && node apps/lab-skills/bin/lab-skills.mjs plan --tui
